title: UNDERNEATH: Basalt Cavern

experience.tagline: Descend through the basalt caverns, uncover the station, and find the monorail route onward.
experience.loadingNote: This ThruHold is preparing its cavern world and lighting. First launch can take a little longer.
tips: Follow the cave route toward the hidden station beneath the island.
Use E to interact with doors and machinery when an action prompt appears.
The portal links this cavern ThruHold to another world; each side can have its own destination.
Look for the monorail and the signs that explain where its route leads.
